'''Reena Vari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi Consular]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] of the [[Galactic War]] she was posted at the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]], [[Jedi instructor|instructing]] other Consulars.<ref name="SW:TOR" />
